name: Hyper Dragon Flamethrower
summary: Paid UEFN weapon system with animated dragon flamethrower models, a vending machine, VFX and an in-island purchase UI.
description: A Payhip product page for a complete custom weapon system made for UEFN creators. It includes custom animated weapon models and VFX, a built-in vending machine with V-Buck offers, in-island purchase offers and transactions, NPC and zombie damage support, ammo configuration and a fully animated UI; everything is configurable from the details panel without code.
